mechanism: Alendronate may impair gastrointestinal motility and absorption while haloperidol has anticholinergic effects that further reduce GI motility, potentially decreasing alendronate bioavailability and increasing haloperidol levels.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor for reduced bisphosphonate efficacy and increased haloperidol adverse effects; ensure adequate hydration and upright positioning with alendronate.
